functional.summary: Story-level functional roll-up for assistant. The complete loop was exercised LIVE against real Bedrock during task 4's check, from this story's own servers after verifying their working directory: ask a governed question, save it, pin it, reopen either from Explore or the dashboard, and delete. Answers come back VERIFIED with provenance; a question the assistant must not answer is declined rather than guessed at; saved and pinned items open by RE-RUNNING, never by replaying, which is proven by two independent signals rather than asserted - the Bedrock ask took 1434ms while the re-run of the same stored selection took 38ms, and the re-run's audit row carries model_id NULL. Nothing durable holds an answer: the snapshot machinery was deleted outright and no payload carries a ResultTable. Each task's own functional check was recorded and CI-verified at its PR.
manual_validation_steps: Task 1 (#42): a data question returns success with provenance.verified true; 'Why is labour high?' is declined rather than answered; 'capital of France?' returns not_supported; a greeting takes the deterministic path and never reaches the model.

Task 2 (#43): the docked Ask panel and the standalone /ask page render from the same component, the verified badge and provenance disclosure appear, and view-in-report shows its link only when the response carries one.

Task 3 (#44): the two-table migration applies to a database holding only 0000_auth_audit.sql, creating exactly saved_queries and dashboard_pins on an isolated scratch database, with a dead-port control failing the same leaf.

Task 4 (#45): Explore is reachable from the nav (it had no href before), saved rows are labelled from the shared catalog constant ('Actual · Budget', not raw ids), Save view and Pin report create (POST /api/saved 201, POST /api/pins 201), opening re-runs and renders through the existing renderer, pinned cards are metadata-only and the dashboard performs no fan-out (exactly 2 /api/chat calls existed across the session), delete works and returns the empty state.
Audit trail confirmed in the database during the live run: exploration.pins.request x8 and exploration.saved.request x3, so the fail-closed audit fires on these surfaces.

Bedrock confirmed configured by BEHAVIOUR, never by reading secrets: provider bedrock, region ap-south-1, model id set, bearer token present, and a real call returning a selection rather than the mock provider's clarification.
non_blocking_findings: The exploration error copy is proven by unit leaf and source inspection rather than live: with the backend stopped the session guard intercepts first with its own message, so the exploration-specific copy is not reachable that way without changing code.
A missing migration surfaces as an unhandled 500 rather than anything diagnosable - observed live before the dev app DB was migrated. Already covered by D-0033 and D-0039.

Carried and still unanswered: no 3F location is recorded anywhere in docs/, so ap-south-1 rests on the code default plus decision 0003's India-residency line. Decision 0027 should be amended if a real residency requirement exists.

Carried: the configured Bedrock model is mistral.mistral-large-3-675b-instruct, not a Claude model. 0027 fixes provider and region, not model family, so this is compliant - but answer quality rides on it.
